headers.LOOK: absolute path to one file, or unavailable

surfaces.look: print LOOK and FORMAT. never the integer
surfaces.observe: print string=integer for one key. unknown key does not list keys
surfaces.verify: host check. fail closed. do not echo expected integer
surfaces.wrap: run command; on success rotate canary and print LOOK
surfaces.scan: fail on store dir, pointer files, or live integers in a tree
